map.提示：LVEF采用Simpson双平面法最为准确。LVESV≥40mL且LVEF: Note: LVEF by Simpson biplane is most accurate. LVESV>=40mL and LVEF<=35% is ICD primary-prevention indication. Aneurysm/dyskinesis is common after large anterior MI. Diastolic function needs E/e', LAVI, TR peak velocity combined. For clinical reference only.
map.LVEF 分级解读：左室射血分数 ≥55% 正常、40%–54% 轻度下降、<4: LVEF grading: >=55% normal, 40%-54% mildly reduced, <40% reduced (HFrEF), judged with volumes.
map.节段室壁运动评分：按 17 节段评估运动（正常/运动减弱/无运动/矛盾/室壁瘤）: Segmental wall motion score: 17 segments rated (normal/hypokinetic/akinetic/dyskinetic/aneurysm); higher total means larger ischemia/infarct.
map.舒张功能评估：以 E/e'、左房大小、TR 速度等判定舒张功能障碍分级，辅助 H: Diastolic function: E/e', left atrial size, TR velocity grade diastolic dysfunction, aiding HFpEF diagnosis and filling-pressure estimate.
map.输入：LVEF 38%、左室舒张末径 58 mm、E/e' 15、左房前后径 4: Input: LVEF 38%, LVIDd 58 mm, E/e' 15, LA diameter 42 mm, segment score 27 (17 segments). Output: systolic reduced (HFrEF), diastolic likely II-III, note dilated change with raised filling pressure, advice combine BNP/clinical for cause. Note: values measured by sonographer; tool only grades.
map.一般 <40% 为射血分数降低（HFrEF），41%–49% 为轻度降低，≥50: Generally <40% is reduced (HFrEF), 41%-49% mildly reduced, >=50% with symptoms and raised filling pressure is preserved (HFpEF). LVEF affected by load and measurement; combine with volume and clinical.
map.室壁运动评分有何用？: What is wall motion score for?
map.把左室分为 17 节段逐一打分，总分换算为室壁运动指数（WMSI），可定位缺血/: LV divided into 17 segments scored; total to WMSI, localizing ischemia/infarct, assessing extent and revascularization value; segmental abnormality also needs angiography or MRI.
